Class StatsScreen

java.lang.Object
com.view.StatsScreen
public class StatsScreen extends Object
Handles the spending statistics screen for the Masroofy application. Displays a breakdown of spending by category using a visual bar chart, and shows the total amount spent in the active budget cycle.

  • Method Details

    • show

      public void show()
      Displays the spending statistics screen. Aggregates category totals, displays the total spent, and renders the bar chart. Allows the user to navigate to the full history screen or go back.

    • displayTotalSpent

      public void displayTotalSpent(double total)
      Displays the total amount spent in the active budget cycle.
      Parameters:
      total - the grand total spending amount to display

    • renderChart

      public void renderChart(List<CategoryTotal> data, double grandTotal)
      Renders a console-based horizontal bar chart showing spending by category. Each bar's length is proportional to that category's share of the grand total. Displays a message if there is no spending data available.
      Parameters:
      data - the list of CategoryTotal objects to chart
      grandTotal - the total spending across all categories, used to calculate percentages

    • onViewHistory

      public void onViewHistory()
      Navigates to the full transaction history screen. Creates and displays a HistoryScreen for the active cycle.
